name: Trading Tycoon
desc:
💰 WELCOME TO TRADING TYCOON! 📈

Start with nothing and build your way to the top of the trading world! 🤑

📊 TRADE & EARN — Buy low, sell high, and grow your cash
💵 BUILD YOUR EMPIRE — Upgrade your tycoon and unlock new opportunities
🚗 BUY LUXURY — Spend your fortune on expensive cars and exclusive items
🏢 UPGRADE YOUR BUSINESS — Expand your operation and become more successful
🏆 COMPETE — Build more wealth than other players and climb the leaderboards
💎 BECOME A BILLIONAIRE — The bigger your empire gets, the more money you can make!

🔥 Will you become the richest trader?
📈 Play now and start building your empire!

llm.loop: buy low and sell high on a trading screen -> grow cash -> upgrade tycoon business and employees -> buy luxury cars -> climb leaderboards
llm.objectives: become the richest trader, a billionaire
llm.progression: cash, tycoon upgrades, employees, trucks, luxury purchases, leaderboard rank
llm.instructions: trade (buy low, sell high), build and upgrade your empire, buy luxury, compete on leaderboards
unique: stock/crypto style trading charts inside a tycoon
llm.thumbnails: trading chart screens, $1M or $0 gamble, $0 to $1B rags to riches with supercar
llm.complexity_notes: tycoon template plus simulated price charts
